xBRIEFInfo.description: Name the leftover-completion gates on the core learner path
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-swarm

narratives.Description: The course teaches delivery-branch reachability and lifecycle closeout but never grades whether that closeout is tracked, and never names verify:orphan-active, verify:completed-tracked or swarm:finalize-cohort to a learner. A learner who finishes Module 12 believing C7 is the end state will strand active briefs on their first real merge.
narratives.Acceptance: Given the learner-facing tree, when a reader greps curriculum, labs, references and solutions for verify:orphan-active, verify:completed-tracked and swarm:finalize-cohort, then each name is present on at least one core-path surface, and node scripts/verify-module-7.mjs, node scripts/verify-module-12.mjs and npm test all exit 0.
narratives.Traces: deftai/directive-training#22; accepted synthesis 'design-critique: synthesis accepted'; successor lean 5751272452; verified-claims table 5751328539; line cites anchored to dispatch SHA dacc9299
narratives.QualityGate: npm test, plus node scripts/verify-module-7.mjs and node scripts/verify-module-12.mjs. Run deft check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint.
narratives.UserStory: As a learner finishing the core path, I want Module 12 to name the gate that decides whether lifecycle closeout is tracked, so that I do not strand an active brief on my first real merge.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Sharpen references/GLOSSARY.md delivered so closeout must be recorded and tracked on the configured delivery branch. Settle C7's delivered provenance as tracked closeout under that definition, with verify:completed-tracked as the gate that decides it and its failure shape left deliberately uncarded. Recut Module 12's Guided explanation section 4, one recovery row and one misconception, mapping verify:orphan-active to C6 and verify:completed-tracked to the uncarded untracked state. Add one successor sentence to Module 7 section 4 and a non-command Lab 7 Done pointer naming verify:completed-tracked. Add a separate leftover-completion block to references/QUICK-REFERENCE.md outside the Module 7 no-remote Task sequence, naming both verifiers with their preconditions, a lifecycle PR as the general repair, and swarm:finalize-cohort once as named-but-not-invoked. Extend the Module 7 and Module 12 verifiers and their focused tests to lock those statements. Keep the nine-card lock, O12.4, the frozen C7 Delivered key and the capstone mirrors untouched.

items.title: Sharpen the delivered definition in references/GLOSSARY.md

narrative.Acceptance: Given references/GLOSSARY.md, when a reader looks up delivered, then it states that lifecycle closeout must be recorded and tracked on the configured delivery branch, and that a local scope:complete remains valid lifecycle closeout but is not land.

Given Module 12 Guided explanation section 4, when a learner reads the delivery axis, then verify:orphan-active is named as deciding C6 with repair scope:complete and verify:completed-tracked is named as deciding C7 tracked closeout and contrasted with an uncarded untracked state repaired by a lifecycle PR; and when node scripts/verify-module-12.mjs runs, then it exits 0 with exactly nine completion rows and C7 still keyed Delivered.

items.title: Add the successor sentence to Module 7 section 4 and the Lab 7 Done pointer

narrative.Acceptance: Given curriculum/modules/07-scope-lifecycle.md section 4, when a learner finishes the scope:complete and scope:cancel pair, then one sentence states that delivered work additionally requires the completed artifact tracked on the delivery branch and links forward to Module 12; and given the Lab 7 Done statement, when a learner reaches it, then a non-command pointer names verify:completed-tracked while the lab sequence still contains no remote-capable command.

items.title: Add a separate leftover-completion block to references/QUICK-REFERENCE.md

narrative.Acceptance: Given references/QUICK-REFERENCE.md, when a learner reads past the Module 7 no-remote Task block, then a separate labelled block names verify:orphan-active and verify:completed-tracked with their delivery-tip and remote preconditions, names a lifecycle PR as the general repair, and names swarm:finalize-cohort once as a named-but-not-invoked advanced option; and references/SOURCE-BASELINE.md Lab 7 row states that an untracked completed artifact is not land.

items.title: Extend the Module 7 and Module 12 content contracts

narrative.Acceptance: Given node scripts/verify-module-7.mjs and node scripts/verify-module-12.mjs, when either runs against the recut content, then it exits 0; and when the Lab 7 Done pointer verify:completed-tracked name or the Quick Reference swarm-closer treatment is removed, then the focused tests in scripts/verify-module-7.test.mjs and scripts/verify-module-12.test.mjs fail.

acceptance.derived_reason: derived 5 independently testable clauses from the task statement before product edit (#3323)

clauses.text: delivered means lifecycle closeout is recorded and tracked on the configured delivery branch. Local scope:complete stays valid lifecycle closeout; it is not land.

C7's delivered provenance means tracked closeout under the sharpened glossary, and verify:completed-tracked is the gate that decides C7. Its failure shape (reachable, locally completed, untracked) is a state the nine-card set deliberately does not carry. Guided explanation section 4, one recovery row and one misconception ('Completed means landed') are recut. verify:orphan-active maps to C6 with repair scope:complete; verify:completed-tracked is the contrast with the uncarded untracked-closeout state with repair a lifecycle PR, not a contrast with C7. The nine-card lock, O12.4, the Module 12 solution table and the frozen C7 Delivered key are kept. No C10. Capstone S5/S6 inherit the sharpened definition and are not edited.

curriculum/modules/07-scope-lifecycle.md section 4 gains one sentence after the scope:complete / scope:cancel pair: local completion proves lifecycle mechanism, and delivered work additionally requires the completed artifact tracked on the delivery branch, with a forward link to Module 12. The labs/07-scope-lifecycle.md Done statement gains a non-command forward pointer to Module 12 that names verify:completed-tracked and states leftover-completion / tracked closeout is not claimed by this no-remote lab. No remote-capable commands and no swarm:finalize-cohort in the lab sequence.

Leftover-completion verbs are not appended inside the Module 7 no-remote Task block. A separate block, labelled outside that sequence, names verify:orphan-active and verify:completed-tracked with delivery-tip and remote preconditions, names a lifecycle PR as the general repair, and names swarm:finalize-cohort once as a named-but-not-invoked advanced orchestration option whose operation stays in parked electives and the AGENTS.md Envelope SLA. That swarm name is mandatory on this surface, not optional. references/SOURCE-BASELINE.md's Lab 7 row is extended: untracked completed/ is not land.

scripts/verify-module-7.mjs and scripts/verify-module-7.test.mjs lock the Lab 7 Done pointer's verify:completed-tracked name and the advanced / non-runnable treatment of the swarm closer on the Quick Reference surface as an explicit assertion, since Quick Reference sits outside the existing forbiddenShell loop. scripts/verify-module-12.mjs and scripts/verify-module-12.test.mjs lock the Module 12 mapping of verify:orphan-active to C6 and verify:completed-tracked to the uncarded untracked-closeout state, plus the tracked-delivery wording. No new verifier. The nine-card negative test is not recut into a tenth card.

expected_outputs: verify:orphan-active, verify:completed-tracked and swarm:finalize-cohort each appear on a learner-facing surface
node scripts/verify-module-7.mjs and node scripts/verify-module-12.mjs exit 0 and lock the new statements
npm test exits 0 with the nine-card Module 12 lock intact
